subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan keys, should OpenClaw steer users away from `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`, add a separate key/route distinction, or treat this as unsupported entitlement with clearer diagnostics?
rationale: The source shows a plausible setup/runtime mismatch, but the correct product behavior depends on Volcengine's live entitlement contract and whether Lite keys are intended to work on the general DeepSeek endpoint.

options.title: Validate Lite contract first
options.body: Use a redacted Lite/Coding Plan key to compare the general DeepSeek route and the coding route, then update provider routing or diagnostics to match the endpoint that actually accepts the key.

options.title: Treat Lite keys as coding-only
options.body: Keep one stored key but guide Lite/Coding Plan users toward `volcengine-plan` models and show a clear diagnostic when a general Volcengine row is selected with an incompatible key.

options.title: Document unsupported entitlement
options.body: If live proof shows this key type is outside supported OpenClaw Volcengine routes, keep the runtime behavior and improve setup/troubleshooting copy instead of changing catalog routing.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite contract first
recommendation.body: Use a redacted Lite/Coding Plan key to compare the general DeepSeek route and the coding route, then update provider routing or diagnostics to match the endpoint that actually accepts the key.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current history owner for the Volcengine plugin manifest and provider-auth alias surface that would need the decision applied.
